about: Rob Vinall 于 2006 年创立 RV Capital，现任管理董事；Andreas Lechner 是共同管理董事。公司位于瑞士。
Rob Vinall founded RV Capital in 2006 and is its managing director. Andreas Lechner is co-managing director. The firm is based in Switzerland.
RV 为机构客户管理独立账户，并为 Business Owner Fund 提供投资顾问服务；本页的 RV Capital AG 13F 不代表基金所有全球资产。
RV manages institutional separate accounts and advises the Business Owner Fund. Its RV Capital AG 13F does not represent all global fund assets.
